items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: A young fine trumpet man by the name of Walter Darwin played trumpet with us for a while

ctx.x: And do you remember the trumpet player, the trombone player, any of them?

Well, we had different trumpet players that went through in that three or four years. Even Rene LeWap went through it for a while. Oh. Your current day popular Rene LeWap who plays all these carnival balls and does a wonderful job. Rene went through it for several months, maybe six or eight months. I don't recall how long each man stayed. A young fine trumpet man by the name of Walter Darwin played trumpet with us for a while and he was I think pretty active in the Lions Club lately or in the last few years. I…
And the trombone players you don't remember?
